PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

Use expenses & insights well

  • Use a stable set of meaningful categories.
  • Record expenses promptly and retain source documents separately.
  • Do not treat a dashboard estimate as tax or accounting advice.
Always confirm the legal, tax, and record-keeping requirements that apply to your business.
